Hobnobs Choco Chips Cookies: Oats (36%), Wheat Flour (Atta), Edible Vegetable Oil (Palm Oil), Choco Chips (15%) [Sugar, Edible Vegetable Fat (Hydrogenated), Cocoa Solids, Emulsifier (INS 492), Dextrose, Emulsifier (INS 322(i)-Lecithin of Soya Origin), Nature Identical Flavouring Substances], Sugar, Invert Sugar Syrup, Raising Agents (INS 500(ii), INS 503(ii)), Milk Solids, Wheat Bran, Honey, Iodised Salt, Emulsifiers [INS 471, INS 322], Nature Identical Flavouring Substances.
Hobnobs Hazelnut & Dark Choco Chips: Oats (31.6%), Wheat Flour (Atta), Edible Vegetable Oil (Palm Oil), Sugar, Dark Choco Chips (10.2%) [Sugar, Cocoa Solids (25%), Hydrogenated Edible Vegetable Oil (Palm Kernel Oil), Dextrose, Emulsifier (INS 322), Salt, Nature Identical Flavour (Vanillin)], Invert Sugar Syrup, Almonds, Wheat Bran, Raising Agents [INS 503(ii), INS 500(ii)], Iodised Salt, Milk Solids, Hazelnut Paste (0.5%), Nature Identical Flavouring Substances, Emulsifiers [INS 471, INS 322], Cocoa Solids.
